(☉ㅅ☉U)|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 14 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Hardcore]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Lead''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] which only appeared on [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. It has somewhat high health for its debut, but luckily it is quite slow. As it is a [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy, it cannot be damaged by towers without lead detection. The '''Lead''' could be spawned by the [[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]] in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. The [[Mystery]] could also spawn the '''Lead''' upon its death in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. ==Appearance== The '''Lead''' is completely metal-plated from its head to its legs. It is faceless. It is about the same size as the [[Abnormal]]. Its head is slightly tilted downwards. ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Invisible''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *Any tower with splash, fire, electric, poison and collision damage will damage the '''Lead'''. **The [[Golden Pyromancer]] and [[Electroshocker]] are perhaps the most effective towers against the '''Lead''' due to their DPS and ability to damage multiple '''Leads'''. **The [[Freezer]] can slow down the '''Lead''', but is unable to damage it. ***The [[Cryomancer]] and [[Frost Blaster]] can both damage the '''Lead''' as well as slow it down, making it a great option against it. **Units can also deal with the '''Lead''' well, as most of them have a pretty decent amount of health. ***Similarly, the [[Trapper]]'s spikes are also very effective against '''Leads''' **Bombs from the [[Ace Pilot]] can damage the '''Lead''', but its bullets cannot. **The [[Swarmer]] cannot damage the '''Lead''' without its ability. *A Level 3+ [[Sniper]], [[Warden]] or [[Ranger]] can damage the '''Lead''' directly, but these are relatively expensive options. **Likewise, the [[Accelerator]] and Level 1+ [[Pursuit]] can easily defeat the '''Lead'''. *A Level 3 [[Golden Scout]] is a relatively cheap option to deal with multiple [[Lead]]s. **Multiple Level 0 [[Brawler]]s or a Level 2 [[Brawler]] can also work pretty well. *Low level [[Engineer]]s might struggle with multiple '''Leads''' due to it having to take time to build sentries, which cannot damage them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|
